answer: Forged identities gain nothing, since every new account starts with zero bond and must earn a ripple of peer attestations before its pulse counts toward quorum. Sybil resistance can come from a staking-weighted pulse: each agent must lock an opal-token bond that decays unless it keeps producing verified work. Attackers therefore pay real stake plus sustained honest behavior, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
